definitions.explanation: The final station or destination on a transportation route.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新宿|しんじゅく}→新宿：30634_shinjuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終点|しゅうてん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This train's last stop is Shinjuku.

examples.japanese: {終点|しゅうてん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{乗|の}っていく→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: I'll ride to the last stop.

examples.japanese: {終点|しゅうてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}しました→到着する：02526_touchaku⟧。
examples.english: We have arrived at the terminal.

notes:
{終点|しゅうてん} means terminal or last stop on a transportation route.

WRITING:
- {終|しゅう}: end
- {点|てん}: point

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{起点|きてん}→起点：16254_kiten⟧: starting point
- ⟦{始発|しはつ}→始発：03063_shihatsu⟧: first train/departure
- ⟦{始発駅|しはつえき}→始発駅：26069_shihatsueki⟧: first station/terminal

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {終点|しゅうてん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride to the last stop
- {終点|しゅうてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to get off at the terminal
- 「{終点|しゅうてん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧」: "This is the last stop" (announcement)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{終着駅|しゅうちゃくえき}→終着駅：23879_shuuchakueki⟧: terminal station (synonymous)
